notes: EN25. Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/ECON-ug.html. All major courses (including electives) must be passed with C- or better; minimum 2.0 major GPA. No more than four upper-division courses may be transferred from outside UC San Diego. B.A. has lighter lower-division and a two-quarter intermediate micro sequence (100A-B) vs the B.S. Catalog confirms only ECON 100A-B required (not C); the five electives may include ECON 100C. Total 11 courses minimum.

buckets.label: Calculus sequence (complete one full sequence)
buckets.note: Complete either MATH 10A-B-C or MATH 20A-B-C (20-series recommended). Do not mix sequences.

buckets.label: Principles of Economics
buckets.note: ECON 1 (principles of microeconomics) and ECON 3 (principles of macroeconomics), both required.

buckets.label: Intermediate Microeconomics
buckets.note: Two-quarter sequence for the B.A. Catalog confirms only 100A-B required.

buckets.label: Upper-division economics electives
buckets.note: Five additional upper-division economics courses (ECON 100-199), excluding those already used to satisfy core requirements. May include ECON 100C. No advanced-list requirement for the B.A.
